title: Will A Recession Sink The Tanker Market
section_path: Will A Recession Sink The Tanker Market
section_path_text: Will A Recession Sink The Tanker Market
summary: What would the likely impact of a global recession be? Ever since inflation rose dramatically earlier this year and especially after oil prices increased dramatically following the Russian invasion of Ukraine, the world is increasingly worried about a potential recession. The Chinese economy, which is crucial for the tanker market, is suffering from Covid lockdowns and from a financial housing crisis.
